headline: Stocks try to rebound from an AI-led rout (S&P 500 -8.6% last week) with core PCE and GDP due Wednesday and oil sliding on Iran-talks hopes.
rates: The 2-year yield is about 4.69% and the 10-year about 4.92-4.93%, with yields ticking up Monday.
fed: NY Fed's Williams spoke Monday 4:00 PM ET; a headline says markets price a 25bp December hike, and the December decision is Dec 9.
oil: WTI settled at $80.17 (-4.5%) and Brent at $89.37 (-3.5%) Monday as hedges against a weekend US escalation unwound and the IEA sees a ~2 mb/d surplus.
geo: The US-Iran war and naval blockade continue, with Hormuz tanker attacks and an Iranian strike on Bahrain over the weekend, though Trump is giving talks time.
